# opnsense_bind_acl (Resource)

BIND access control lists (**Services ▸ BIND ▸ Configuration ▸ ACLs**, plugin `os-bind`), used by the settings and the zones.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_bind_acl" "lan" {
  name     = "lan"
  networks = ["10.0.10.0/24"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Set the name for this ACL.
- `networks` (Set of String) List of networks for this ACL.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) This will enable or disable the ACL. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the BIND ACL.
